item.coloph: de ltar slob dpon gsang ba'i dril bsgrubs (sgrub/)man ngag gsang ba'i gnad don zhes bya ba/ slob dpon rje btsun chen po'i thugs bcud phyungs ste (te)/ phyi rab (rabs) 'gro ba rmongs pa'i don dgongs ste (te/)mchog thun dngos grub ma lus byung ba dang / gnam thel gza' dang rgyal 'gong 'dul ba dang / rang rig ye shes bdag gzhal (zhal) mthong ba'i phyir/ bla chen yab sras thugs bcud dril bsgrub (sgrub) 'di/ rig 'dzin yab sras thugs kyi mdzod bskul te/ g.yung drung 'od du 'bar ba'i brag phug tu/ ba gor mkhan po b+he ro tsa na dang / stang chen dmu tsa gyer med dang / yum chen mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma la/ phyi rab (rabs) bstan pa'i don du gnyer gtad du/ dus kyi mtha' la dar ba'i smon lam btab/ de nas dus dang las kyis dbang bsgyar nas/ gnas mchog dam pa shel le rdzong rdzog (drug) tu/ yum chen mkha' 'gro srid pa'i rgya mo(mos/)dus mtha'i rnal 'byor u rgyan gling pa la/ bsnyan snyan) du brgyud nas bstan pa'i gnyer yang gtad/ mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung gis rab bskul nas/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i sa thob shog/
